arguments.statement: ∀ (B : Module.Basis (Fin (lam.toNat + 1)) K (VK K M)) (w : VK K M), w ≠ 0 → ∃ j : Fin (lam.toNat + 1), B.repr w j ≠ 0
arguments.proof:
intro B w hw
classical
by_contra hn
apply hw
apply B.repr.injective
have hc : ∀ j, B.repr w j = 0 := by simpa only [not_exists, not_not] using hn
simpa using (show B.repr w = 0 from Finsupp.ext hc)
